items.title: Insurance Dementia Campaign Expands Beyond London
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, insurance United Against Dementia has raised over £13m since 2017 and is now targeting regional markets, life firms, and reinsurers for its next phase.

items.title: Search Underway for the UK's Top Insurance Employers 2027
items.summary: Insurance Business UK launches its annual workplace excellence ranking, supported by the Insurance Cultural Awareness Network.

items.title: L&G Takes On £2.45bn Royal Mail DC Scheme in Record Master Trust Transfer
items.summary: According to Professional Pensions, the completed transition moves £2.45bn in assets and approximately 100,000 members into the L&G Mastertrust.

items.title: Chubb Appoints New Head of Financial Lines for CEMENA
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, lucas Scortecci takes on the regional role covering Continental Europe, Middle East and North Africa, starting in December.

items.title: Specialty Insurance Softening Accelerates, WTW Reports
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, according to WTW's Specialty Insurance Marketplace Survey, specialty insurance rates fell at double the pace of the previous year.

items.title: WTW Recommends Tailored Key Performance Indicators for Captives
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, advisory firm suggests captive owners move away from traditional insurance metrics in favour of aligned strategic goals.
